content: PostHog's consent model: call posthog.opt_out_capturing() / opt_in_capturing() from your banner's accept/decline handlers; PostHog also supports cookieless_mode: 'on_reject' so events fire without personal identifiers until a user explicitly opts in. PostHog publishes official React and Vue cookie-banner tutorials showing this exact wiring. Recommended verification: confirm zero requests to the PostHog host before consent, an  event + POST to /e/ and /s/ (session recording) endpoints only after consent.
